notes.title: DCU Patch 0.5.9 - Custom Radio, Graphic Settings and Gamepad Support
notes.content:
[p]Greetings from HSG®

Introducing DCU Patch 0.5.9 with Custom Radio and its functionalities and optimized Gamepad support for Twin Stick Controllers with and without sensitivity Back Trigger Buttons. A key map is added in the Keybinds settings screen and more presets will be added later as a well as user defined key binding option. Some General Graphic settings are added in the settings for now and the other will be added later on. Also in general fixes and improvements are made.

List with things that done in this patch:
[/p][list][*][p]Added Radio with functionalities like a real radio.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Gamepad Preset (User can still modify their Gamepad keybinds through steam).[/p][/*][*][p]Added basic Graphics Settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Direct X Level Selection on Steam when launching the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Sound Mastering (Music).[/p][/*][*][p]Added Volume Sliders in-game options menu (Overall, SFX and Music).[/p][/*][*][p]Added Terrain Physics and Sound (More optimization later).[/p][/*][*][p]Minor Bug Fixes.[/p][/*][/list][p]
New on the upcoming patches:
[/p][list][*][p]Realistic car engine sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Customizable License Plate (User Type Input)[/p][/*][*][p]Night mode[/p][/*][*][p]New places[/p][/*][*][p]New Cars[/p][/*][*][p]User Keybinds (Keyboard and Gamepad)[/p][/*][*][p]Controller Presets[/p][/*][*][p]More detailed Main Menu Options[/p][/*][*][p]More Radio Songs[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized Top-Down Camera[/p][/*][*][p]Performance Improvements[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thumbs up and take care!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43490528/16339827e64731b7afc4c5507144178fc5ef4970.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Town under development and plans for the future.
notes.content:
Greatings

We are about to create cities that are connected each other via rally style racing tracks giving the game a touch of rally exploring. Each city will be connected each other with roads of 3 to 5 kilometers from city to city or town. Each city or town will have different styles like Villages, Small Towns, Industrial compounds and different places.

Our Team is now working on a new update which coming very soon.
We creating a 1 single new town far from city which players can drive from the city that already exists to the town via a racetrack. Its all about traveling from city to city with a feeling of rally like Dirt and Colin McRae. The map will be quite big and open world. Each Town/City will be connected each other and there also be highlands roads through nature industrial etc.

More updates are coming later with new place cars and features.

Thank you for your support.
